svg.title: 13 attitude phase and authority
svg.desc: Synthetic one-axis PD attitude response and actuator authority. The phase portrait is colored by elapsed model time. Requested torque is reconstructed from the recorded states and sidecar gains; the applied torque is clipped to ±8 mN·m. The right panel focuses on the first 40 seconds, while the phase portrait uses the full 120-second record.
